title: One full rotation
text: If we start at the point D and rotate $$2\pi$$ radians, you end up back where you started.

title: Extrapolate
text: You can complete multiple full rotations and end up at the same location. This tells us that $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}, $$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+2\pi,$$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+4\pi,$$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+6\pi,$$ ... are all equivalent radian measures.

title: Change directions
text: You can also rotate in the opposite direction, and end up back at the same point. This means that other angles that describe the point are ..., $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}-4\pi, $$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}-2\pi, $$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}, $$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+2\pi,$$ $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+4\pi,$$ ... also written as $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}+2n\pi=\frac{-\pi}{3}+2n\pi,$$ where $$n$$ is any integer.
